products.name: Zenith Carbon-X
products.description: Built for elite racers, the Zenith Carbon-X blends an aggressive full-length carbon fiber propulsion plate with responsive, dual-density bio-foam cushioning. Its weightless aero-weave mesh is engineered for speed, offering breathable lockdowns through high-speed mileage.
features: Aero-weave carbon flyplate for maximal snapback propulsion

products.name: AeroCraft Retro '85
products.description: An homage to the golden era of court hoops. Features rich, full-grain cream leather overlays, supple perforated ventilation chambers on the toe box, and solid vintage forest green ankle guards. Built upon a classic stitched rubber cupsole and a heavy-traction vintage gum sole.
features: Full-grain calfskin leather for pristine longevity
Stitched protective cupsole with internal Air cushioning

products.name: KnitFlow Bare
products.description: Crafted like a second skin, the KnitFlow Bare strips sneakers down to the absolute essentials. Features an eco-engineered, zero-waste stitch knit body and a flexible barefoot-inspired bio-algae foam sole that flexes instantly with your foot.
features: Ultra-flexible bio-based algae shock absorption outsole

products.name: VaporMax Pulse
products.description: The peak of pressurized air comfort. Engineered with independent multi-pod VaporMax responsive bubbles, creating instant springback. Fitted with structured dynamic lace lock cords for rapid adjustments.
features: Dynamic lock cords for instant secure fit
Post-consumer recycled ocean plastic mesh knit

products.name: Court Classic Lux
products.description: Minimalism meets elite craftsmanship. Cut with buttery soft nappa leather panels and clean hand-bound tonal stitches. Exquisite comfort is achieved through a fully leather-lined collar and orthotic micro-cushions.
features: Ultra soft top-grade Nappa leather finish

products.name: Apex Trail-Blazer
products.description: The rugged adventurer. Fitted with advanced non-porous moisture repelling ripstop textures and heavy vulcanized framing buffers. Aggressive deep-groove tread sole layout ensures steady climbing stability.
features: Micro-dense water shield repelling outer weave

reviews.title: Best speed shoe I've ever laced up!
reviews.comment: The pop you get from the carbon flyplate is absolutely insane. Put these on for a local 10k and immediately shaved 45 seconds off my PR. Unrivaled speed, super airy mesh.

reviews.title: Incredibly snappy but very narrow
reviews.comment: Materials and energy feedback are unmatched, but make sure to size up if your foot run wide. The middle lockdown is intense. Highly recommend the Pulse Orange colorway, visible from a mile away!

reviews.title: Breathtaking leather quality!
reviews.comment: The cream cowhide leather on these feels incredibly soft, far superior to standard mass-produced retro releases. The forest green contrasts pair incredibly with casual cargo pants or retro sports denim. Worth every penny.

reviews.title: Insane comfort, feels like an elite sock
reviews.comment: I wear these to the office and long commutes without socks. Genuinely feels like wearing high-end merino socks with a cloud glued underneath. I got the Oatmeal Sand variant and receive complements constantly.

reviews.title: Prada-level craftsmanship at a third of the price
reviews.comment: Honestly astonished by the stitch alignment and leather finishing here. Reminds me of premium designer brands. Extremely clean with sleek linen suits.
